body.heading: Where in the world is Haiti?
paragraphs: Haiti is a country in the Caribbean, which is part of North America. It is an island country, surrounded by sea.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Haiti is Port-au-Prince.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Haiti speak Haitian Creole and French.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Haiti is the Haitian gourde.

body.heading: How big is Haiti?
paragraphs: Haiti covers about 28,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about twice the size of The Bahamas.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: The Citadelle is the largest fortress in the Americas — a mountaintop stronghold built after independence, with walls 40 metres high and views to the sea.
Near Cap-Haïtien, Labadie is a sheltered cove of clear water and white sand beneath green hills — Haiti's best-known beach day.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Haiti on a map or globe. Which continent is it nearest to — and what sea or ocean surrounds it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: Haiti in one breath: a country in the Caribbean, capital Port-au-Prince, where people speak Haitian Creole and pay with the Haitian gourde.
